entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eachaid mac Muiredaig Muinderg was a king of Ulaid from the Dál Fiatach. He was the son of Muiredach Muinderg mac Forggo. His death date is given in the Annals of Tigernach in 509. This annal gives him a reign of 489–509.
